## Context
Split from `upbeat-illadvised-springtail` (155c-218b-...) per operator decision 2026-08-19. That
ticket originally carried BOTH the research (which endpoints can move) and the change (moving them).
The research must not sit behind the migration's acceptance criteria, so it is filed here and
springtail is now blocked by it.

Pydantic AI v2 makes the Responses API the default for `openai:`. rebar currently pins Chat
Completions explicitly via the `openai-chat:` prefix (the deprecation repair on
`dragonish-sylphic-sheep`). rebar should migrate deliberately, after proving compatibility, rather
than inherit the semantic change implicitly.

## Scope — evidence only, no migration
Inventory every OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible endpoint rebar supports, including custom base URLs,
and establish for each whether it is Responses-ready or must remain Chat-Completions-only. Cover
structured output, streaming, tool calls, retries, and provider-specific settings.

This ticket does NOT flip any provider to `openai-responses:`. Its product is the matrix plus the
contract tests that will later prove the migration safe.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A provider capability matrix identifies each supported OpenAI-compatible endpoint as
      Responses-ready or Chat-Completions-only, with CITED evidence per row (not inference).
- [ ] Contract tests exercise REAL pydantic-ai model construction (not mocks of it) and assert
      structured-output, streaming, tool-call, retry, and custom-base-URL behaviour.
- [ ] The tests are written so they can be re-run against both `openai-chat:` and
      `openai-responses:` to produce a behavioural diff — that diff is the migration's evidence.
- [ ] Any endpoint whose status cannot be established from evidence is recorded as UNKNOWN with the
      specific missing evidence named, rather than assumed either way.
- [ ] `make test`, `make lint`, `make typecheck` pass.
compiled_state.title: OpenAI Responses API: provider capability matrix and production-construction contract tests
